children: Geojit Financial Services, Deepa Jewellers Ltd

Deepa Jewellers Ltd (Deepa), incorporated in 2016, is a B2B designer, processor, and supplier of hallmarked 22-karat gold jewellery, primarily catering to retailers across South India. The company offers 16 product categories and 110 SKUs, including vaddanam, CNC machine-cut bangles, kadas, necklaces, earrings, and rings. It follows an asset-light outsourced manufacturing model through a network of 41 karigars, supported by an in-house design team of 15 designers. As of July 31, 2026, Deepa served 373 customers across 13 states and one union territory, including jewellery chains such as Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, and Lalithaa Jewellery. India's B2B gems & jewellery industry, estimated at ₹7,301 billion, is expected to grow at 2-3% through FY30, driven by stable gold prices, demand recovery, organized retail expansion, and export growth. The topline grew at a CAGR of ~37% to ₹1,927cr in FY26 from FY24, driven by an expanding customer base, wider geographic presence, strong demand for traditional South Indian jewellery, and a diversified product portfolio.
The asset-light model, improved operating efficiencies, and upcoming manufacturing facility are expected to support sustained growth and profitability. Hence, we assign a
rating for short to medium-term investors.
